question: What Is Circuit Breaker Coordination and Selectivity?
body_html:
Circuit breaker coordination means only the breaker closest to a fault trips while every upstream breaker stays closed. On a log log time current curve, the downstream curve must sit fully below the upstream curve up to the maximum fault current.

Selectivity TypeHow It Works
TimeUpstream short time delay, about 0.1 to 0.4 s
CurrentUpstream instantaneous pickup above downstream fault current
Zone selective interlockingTrip units signal upstream breaker to wait
EnergyDownstream current limiting device clears fault first
